story_description: As a developer, I need a Swift adapter that communicates with the Codex app-server via bidirectional stdio JSON-RPC so that Blaze can send prompts and receive streaming responses without HTTP transport.
task: Build CodexStdioAdapter with Process pipe management
task_description: Create CodexStdioAdapter actor that spawns codex app-server process, writes JSON-RPC requests to stdin, reads JSON-RPC responses and notifications from stdout, correlates responses to pending requests via CheckedContinuation, and exposes an AsyncStream for notifications.
atom_description: Implement CodexStdioAdapter actor with: (1) spawn codex app-server with piped stdin/stdout/stderr, (2) atomic request ID counter, (3) pending request map keyed by ID with CheckedContinuation, (4) stdout reader task parsing newline-delimited JSON, (5) stdin writer for JSON-RPC requests, (6) AsyncStream of notifications for UI events, (7) graceful shutdown with SIGTERM then SIGKILL.
problem_statement: The current F008 architecture assumes HTTP transport for Codex communication, but CodexMonitor (the reference Tauri app) demonstrates that codex app-server uses stdio JSON-RPC. Without a proper stdio adapter, Blaze cannot integrate with Codex CLI. This atom creates the foundational bidirectional pipe communication layer that all higher-level Codex features will depend on.
scope_in: Define CodexStdioAdapter actor with isolated state
Spawn codex app-server process with stdin/stdout/stderr pipes
Create AtomicInteger class for thread-safe request ID generation
Define pendingRequests dictionary mapping request ID to CheckedContinuation
Implement readLoop task that reads stdout line-by-line and parses JSON
Route JSON-RPC responses to matching pending continuation
Route JSON-RPC notifications to AsyncStream for subscribers
Implement sendRequest method that writes JSON-RPC to stdin and awaits response
Handle process termination and restart logic
Implement graceful shutdown with SIGTERM followed by SIGKILL timeout
scope_out: Codex protocol message types (defined in separate T002 atom)
Authentication and session management with Codex
Error recovery and automatic reconnection policies
assumptions: codex app-server binary is available on PATH or at known location
codex app-server uses newline-delimited JSON-RPC over stdio
JSON-RPC 2.0 protocol with id field for request-response correlation
Notifications have null id field per JSON-RPC spec
Process can be terminated and restarted without state loss
constraints: Must use Swift concurrency (async/await) not completion handlers
Actor isolation required for thread-safe pending request map access
Must handle partial JSON reads across buffer boundaries
Must not block main thread during stdio operations
Process must be cleaned up on adapter deallocation
functional_requirements: CodexStdioAdapter.start() spawns process and begins read loop
Request ID increments atomically for each request
Pending request continuation resumes when matching response arrives
Notifications without request ID are published to notification stream
Process stderr is captured for debugging and error reporting
Adapter detects process exit and updates connection state
nonfunctional_requirements: Request-response latency overhead under 5ms for pipe operations
Memory usage stable during long-running sessions (no continuation leaks)
Graceful degradation when codex binary not found
All public API methods are async and Sendable-safe
implementation_steps: Define CodexStdioAdapter actor with process, pendingRequests, notificationContinuation properties
Create AtomicInteger class using OSAtomicIncrement64 for request IDs
Implement start() method that configures and launches Process with pipes
Implement private readLoop() async method that reads stdout via AsyncBytes
Parse each line as JSON and check for id field presence
If id present, look up and resume matching continuation in pendingRequests
If id null or absent, yield to notificationContinuation as notification
Implement sendRequest<T:Codable>(method:params:) async throws returning T
Generate next request ID, create JSON-RPC request object, write to stdin
Store CheckedContinuation in pendingRequests keyed by request ID
Implement stop() method that sends SIGTERM, waits 2 seconds, then SIGKILL
Implement deinit or explicit cleanup to terminate process
Add stderr capture task that logs to OSLog
Write unit tests for request-response correlation
Write unit tests for notification stream publication
Write integration test with mock process

edge_cases: codex binary not found on PATH - throw descriptive error
Process crashes mid-request - resume all pending continuations with error
Malformed JSON in stdout - log error and skip line
Request timeout after 30 seconds - resume continuation with timeout error
Stdin write fails due to broken pipe - mark adapter as disconnected
Rapid sequential requests - ensure ID uniqueness and correct correlation
failure_modes: Process fails to start: surface error to caller, do not retry automatically
Process exits unexpectedly: cancel all pending requests with ProcessExitedError
JSON parse error: log and continue, do not crash adapter
Continuation leak: implement timeout cleanup for abandoned requests
rollback_plan: Delete Blaze/Sources/Engine/Codex/CodexStdioAdapter.swift and test file. Remove any imports or usages from EngineManager.swift. The adapter is isolated and has no database migrations or persistent state.

Use line-buffered reading and explicit flush on writes
Register for process termination notifications and cleanup in deinit
